new: An eighteenth story: Where memes meet. 29,610 internet memes from Know Your Meme, from the Menche lab's Memes_Data repository, flow from the archive into a network of 17,243 memes tied by the tags they share, with 27 communities in colour.
A year in memes: the 2019 and 2020 networks with their hot topics rising (television and streaming; politics and Trump; TikTok).

Niches on the outside, a commons of classics inside (Doge, Grumpy Cat, Nyan Cat), and a closing hypothesis you meet standing in the middle: crossing between groups, not views, brings a meme to the commons.
In a headset chapters 6 and 7 stand you inside the cloud of memes.
No meme pictures; memes flagged by their own tags or a crude name stay unnamed points.
